description:
Subject: Cluster Node Status – Client 101 (Node ID 2)

The node assigned to client 101 (node ID 2) is currently reachable at IP 192.168.1.12. Its overall cluster health is reported as **UP**, and both the effective state and the general health of the node are also **UP**. This node is acting as the configuration coordinator for the cluster, though it is not the local node from our monitoring perspective. The master state is **ACTIVE**, and the node’s operational state is listed as **ACTIVE** as well. No issues have been detected with jumbo‑frame support, licensing, or RSS key consistency – the flags for “jumbo not supported”, “license mismatch”, and “RSS key mismatch” are all set to false.
